entries.registered_before: any e07 diagnostic output on b6c or b6 hold pools
entries.populations: dev: b6_hold_SCE (400) + 160 b6 SCE octets, lineages s30-32 (inspected in ext-06); diagnostic: b6c_hold_SCE (400) + 320 SCE octets + 160 UCE octets, lineages s35-39 (b6c pool/octets were inspected by ext-06 end-to-end scoring, so these are DIAGNOSTIC, not confirmation)
entries.models: historical LRN, RAWF, SUP, B0 checkpoints (read-only; campaign06)
entries.protocols: B free-running (bit-identical to historical eval required); A common-history (pi* histories and each arm's own histories replayed through every model, own recurrent state rebuilt; low (<.05) / unsupported (<1e-3) history probabilities flagged). Denominators never mixed.
entries.tolerances_frozen: campaign07_diagscore.semantic_tol at merge 1aa9c388: cost-unit coords .005 (= decision eps .5 price units / R); probabilities .05; remaining_queries_rel 1/16; steps_left_rel .25; binary flags .5. Fixed now, before any dev/b6c output; any later tolerance is reported as a sensitivity, not a substitute.
entries.interventions: LRN only, same frozen model + reconstructed state, at the aux output before fusion: pred (identity), exact (all), group replacements G1-G4 (iso/dep/up/keep, dependency closure from factor-contract.json), gauss / gauss_pred / scale_err / mirror perturbations at training-error scale; immediate vs rollout named separately; support membership (range / Mahalanobis / kNN vs 99th pct of LRN's own training predictions) logged for every replaced vector
primary_descriptive_readouts: per-group prediction error and tolerance-hit rate on flip vs near-miss vs invariance octet decisions and by context (query2_after_H / notH, initial, later_query_start)
immediate rescue/harm of exact and group replacement on the same frozen LRN, split by in-support vs out-of-support replacement
common-history decision accuracy LRN vs RAWF vs SUP on pi* histories by context
entries.statistics: two-level bootstrap (seed, then configuration / whole octet), n_boot 20000, boot seed 7, half-split MC check
entries.order: support refs -> dev-s30 smoke -> dev s31/32 -> score-dev -> b6c-s35 smoke (historical check 'identical' for all 4 models) -> b6c s36-39 -> score b6c

entries.branch: B (consumer) + D test via S x R 2x2, chosen from P1-DIAG localization (consumption primary, acquisition secondary)

arms.predictors: separately trained factor predictors with their OWN encoder (5 out-of-fold over training configurations + 1 full-data) per seed
arms.consumers: from-scratch recurrent consumers (SUP architecture) under input contracts exact / oof / mix (half the episodes with noise matched per coordinate to OOF error); each evaluated with EXACT factors (privileged ceiling, diagnostic) and with PREDICTED factors from the full-data separate predictor (deployable)

entries.seeds: 40-44 (training worlds 1.20e10-1.25e10); history bank from dev lineage s30 behaviour on b6_B0 only (worlds 1.29e10), shared by all arms/seeds
entries.evaluation: b6c_hold_SCE (400) + 320 SCE octets (inspected pool: used here as VALIDATION for selection only) + UCE octets (descriptive); campaign07_diag protocols B and cf; scoring campaign07_diagscore two-level 20000 draws seed 7
readouts: 2x2: flip / near-miss / invariance / pool accuracy, gap regret; shaping effect S1R0-S0R0, reading effect S0R1-S0R0, interaction; factor reliance (zero-factor action change) for R1 arms
consumers: same metrics with exact vs predicted inputs; exact->predicted degradation; reliance
entries.selection_rule: Reference = the better (screen pool eps-optimal accuracy) of S1R1 and S1R0 (strong ordinary equal-information baselines). Candidates = DEPLOYABLE arms/consumers (predicted-factor inputs only; exact-factor evaluations never selected). Choose the candidate with the largest mean screen flip-accuracy gain over the reference subject to: near-miss mean diff >= -.05, invariance mean diff >= -.03, pool accuracy >= reference - .02 and >= .70 absolute. If none qualifies (or best flip gain < .03) -> no confirmation of a repair; report branch E / negative and use remaining budget only for a localized follow-up.
entries.budget: ~12k core-s (bank mode); on-policy variants not run in screen

entries.status: registered rule (contrast filled in by P2-SCREEN selection rule; no confirmation data exists)
entries.population: FRESH S+C+E pool b6d: 400 configurations at base 6.43e9 (eval worlds 6.48e9) + 320 fresh octets at CF base 6.66e9; labels built before any confirmation evaluation; never used for selection
entries.lineages: fresh seeds 50-54 (training worlds 1.30e10-1.35e10), 5 paired lineages; same history bank; same recipe as screen; final checkpoint; no selection
entries.primary: flip accuracy (full-member accuracy on unique-optimum flip units of SCE octets, all decision types pooled, whole octets) candidate - reference: mean > 0, two-level (seed pair, then whole octet / configuration) 95% CI lower bound > 0, >= 4/5 pairs positive
entries.non_inferiority: near-miss accuracy mean diff >= -.05; invariance accuracy mean diff >= -.03
entries.competence_floor: b6d pool eps-optimal decision accuracy >= reference - .02 and >= .70 absolute; success >= .8 x pi* success
entries.regret: gap regret difference reported with two-level CI (secondary)
entries.statistics: n_boot 20000, bootstrap seed 20260928 (fixed now), Monte Carlo half-split check reported for every endpoint whose CI bound is within .005 of its threshold; seed-level values and support always reported
entries.decision: SUPPORTED iff primary AND non-inferiority AND competence floor
